events.text: {"verdict":"finish","decision":"Most of the build is already done on disk but has not been recorded or shipped. cloud/src/dashboard.ts has a Content view (Metricool posts and followers, GA4 blog sources, Wistia plays, Tantra newsletter). app/scripts/probe-t468.mjs covers the simulator, utm_content tracing from post to registrations to booked calls, the OS kit .env build and the Not connected fallbacks. Also re-run probe-t265.mjs as a regression check. 2) Run tsc for cloud and app. 3) Confirm the OS kit (revops-os/kits/dashboard, shared with T-457) builds the same panel, then rebuild it with build-kits.sh. 4) Commit, merge to main and push. 5) Deploy the revops-centre Worker. 6) Log the commit, Worker version and probe pass counts on T-468, then move it to review for Adi.","why":"My 2026-10-18 proceed decision set this scope. probe-t468.mjs and the dashboard.ts content reads now exist, so only verifying and shipping remain. Probes use simulator and own-key reads only (vendor-accounts-no-change-rule, owner-provided-live-keys).","outward_ok":["git push of the T-468 work merged to main","wrangler deploy of the revops-centre Worker (no migration unless the probe needs one)"],"reassign_to_claude":true,"adi_input":null}
